exposure: Introduction of High Flow Nasal Cannula (HFNC) outside of Paediatric Critical Care Units (PCCU)
outcome: Predictors of escalation (e.g., age, gender, comorbidities, observations, time to starting HFNC)
cohort: Children, primarily infants (median age 4-6.5 months) admitted for respiratory issues, observed retrospectively in a single hospital for two years before and two years after the introduction of HFNC outside of the Paediatric Critical Care Unit.
finding: No statistically significant predictors of escalation to PCCU were identified among children treated with HFNC outside PCCU, and an observed increase in PCCU admissions with decreased intubations did not reach statistical significance in the pre-post introduction comparison.
